name: Slated
description:
Keyboard-first window management: Slate-compatible shortcuts, layouts, window hints and a placement grid, Caps Lock as a Hyper key, text expansion through espanso, game automation (auto-clicker, held keys, macros) and clipboard history. Reads ~/.config/slated/config.json and settings.json; imports ~/.slate.js or ~/.slate into them once.

Clipboard: clipboard history records the text you copy (not secrets that password managers mark, and not apps you exclude) and keeps it in ~/.local/state/slated/clipboard.json, readable only by you; turn it off with clipboard.enabled. The insert-text action pastes text it can't type through the clipboard, then puts the previous clipboard text back.

Input: automation actions click and press keys through a virtual pointer and keyboard, only for shortcuts you bind; the stop shortcut, switching apps, locking the screen or turning Slated off releases everything.
